summary: Xiao-I Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement to issue a $2.17M unsecured convertible promissory note (net $2M after OID and expenses) with Streeterville Capital, LLC. The note carries 6% interest, matures in 12 months, and includes 325,000 ADSs as pre-delivery shares. This is a convertible debt financing, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer raising working capital. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is routine capital-raising without structural or strategic significance. No watch items or risk-arb angle apply.
